<div class="fusion-panel panel-default"><div class="panel-heading"><h4 class="panel-title toggle"><a class="active" data-toggle="collapse" data-parent="#accordion-1" data-target="#8e74e7178ec1f94c8" href="#8e74e7178ec1f94c8"><i class="fa-fusion-box"></i>Standard Room</a></h4></div><div id="8e74e7178ec1f94c8" class="panel-collapse collapse in"><div class="panel-body toggle-content">
